categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Mingyang Circuit Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs). The company specializes in small-batch PCB manufacturing with a diverse product portfolio including HDI boards, thick copper boards, rigid-flex boards, high-frequency boards, semiconductor test boards, and substrates. Its products serve various sectors such as industrial control, medical health, automotive electronics, semiconductors, smart grids, communication equipment, commercial displays, artificial intelligence, and data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnection (HDI), thick copper processes, rigid-flex combination, glass-based advanced packaging, and thermal management techniques. It has developed proprietary technologies for multi-layer PCBs, Mini LED PCBs, semiconductor test boards, and high-speed large computing products. Production follows a flexible, make-to-order model with stringent quality control and digitalized manufacturing processes integrating SAP, IMS, and SRM systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global EMS companies, PCB traders, and leading enterprises across multiple industries such as industrial control, medical devices, automotive electronics, semiconductors, communications, AI, and data centers. The company has established long-term relationships with renowned international clients like Flextronics, Jabil, Enics, Plexus, Lam Research, Qualcomm, and others. Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, serving markets in Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in Shenzhen, Jiujiang (China), and Malaysia, with sales subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Germany, the United States, Singapore, and Malaysia. Its global sales network covers Europe (Germany, France, Switzerland, Italy), North America (USA), and Asia (Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, South Korea), with ongoing expansion in domestic and Japanese markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Mingyang Circuit Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on PCB manufacturing. It procures raw materials such as copper clad laminates, copper foil, and semi-cured sheets mainly from domestic suppliers and delivers customized PCB products to downstream EMS companies, PCB traders, and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with strategic R&D in high-density interconnection (HDI), advanced packaging (FC-BGA, SiP), RF microwave, high-speed servers, power modules, thermal management, and green manufacturing. It is developing AI server signal integrity solutions, automotive-grade PCB reliability, 6G satellite communication products, and large-scale production capabilities for supercomputing and thermal management PCBs. The R&D centers in Shenzhen and Jiujiang focus on process innovation, material development, reliability studies, and simulation design.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized PCB products, predominantly to overseas customers. The company follows a make-to-order production model with flexible manufacturing to meet small-batch, multi-variety demands. Some sales are conducted via PCB traders who aggregate orders from small and medium-sized end customers. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading specialized manufacturer in the small-batch PCB market segment in China, ranked 40th among China’s top 100 PCB enterprises and 23rd among domestic PCB companies. It competes with global EMS providers and PCB manufacturers, leveraging its technological innovation, quality stability, and globalized service network to maintain a competitive edge in niche, high-precision PCB markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.56 billion, a slight decline of 3.7% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.38 million, down 88.91%. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 3.46 billion with net assets of RMB 2.40 billion, reflecting a 25.82% increase in net assets. Despite recent profit declines due to capacity ramp-up and integration costs, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in growth projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen Mingyang Circuit Technology differentiates itself through its specialization in small-batch, high-mix PCB manufacturing with a comprehensive product range and full-process production capability. It offers one-stop solutions tailored to diverse customer needs with high-quality, stable products certified by multiple international standards. The company’s global footprint, advanced R&D capabilities, flexible production, and strong customer service provide competitive advantages in delivering innovative, high-precision PCBs for emerging technology sectors.
